# Third-party renderer

- Package: Three.js 0.170.0
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js
- License: MIT, preserved in THREE-LICENSE.txt
- Purpose: local WebGL rendering only
- Runtime network: none

Earth imagery is generated in scene.js from approximate continent polygons and seeded surface texture. It is not NASA imagery or a precise geospatial reconstruction.
